name: Dang.ai
tagline: Dang.ai runs like a Product Hunt spinoff dedicated entirely to AI: makers submit tools for community upvotes, and the homepage surfaces whatever is trending that week. Categories cover the usual writing, image, and coding tools, plus a running feed of the newest submissions. It doubles as a launch platform, with a paid option for makers who want faster review and a featured spot.
